connectionFields.obtainedHow: In n8n, create an API key under Settings → n8n API and copy it once.

prepSteps.title: Create an n8n API key
prepSteps.instruction: In the n8n editor, open Settings → n8n API, create a key with access to the instance, and store it in the operator vault. Do not paste it into chat.
prepSteps.evidence: n8n Settings shows an API key entry (value stored outside the session)

uncataloged.evidence: n8n Settings shows an API key entry (value stored outside the session)
